validate_environment: validate the environment for nvidia-modelopt quantization and check device map compatibility
check_if_quantized_param: check if a model parameter is already quantized by the nvidia-modelopt quantizer
create_quantized_param: create a quantized parameter by calibrating and compressing a model module with modelopt
adjust_max_memory: adjust the maximum memory allocation by reducing it to 90 percent for modelopt quantization
process_model_before_weight_loading: process a model before weight loading by applying quantization configuration and excluding specified modules
